name: Festoon
author: Erin Carter
description: A single string of small triangular bunting pennants crosses the frame on a shallow diagonal, anchored high-left and running low off the right. Dozens of crisp flat-shaded SDF triangles, each in its own palette hue, hang from a barely-visible line over near-black. A gust of flutter travels down the string, lifting and snapping each flag's free tip one after another with a bright flash at the peak; between gusts the flags settle into gentle independent idle sway, so the chain is never still and never resets.

params.label: Flag size
params.effect: CSS-pixel length of each pennant; small reads as distant party bunting, large as bold signal flags.

params.label: Gust speed
params.effect: How fast flutter waves travel down the string; at 0 no gusts pass and the flags only idle-sway in place.

params.label: Flutter
params.effect: Amplitude of each flag's lift and snap, from a barely-stirring hang to lively wind-whipped flapping.
